name: Sleep reset
summary: Reset your sleep schedule with a wind-down routine, light and caffeine cutoffs and a 14-night ramp to a steady bedtime.
duration: 14 nights plus 2 weeks to hold it

onboarding.prompt: What time do you usually get to sleep now?
onboarding.reaction: Thanks for being honest. We'll move it in small steps.

onboarding.prompt: What time do you need to wake up?
onboarding.reaction: Great. That anchors the whole plan.
No judgement. We'll build a swap that feels good.

onboarding.prompt: When's your last coffee, tea or energy drink usually?
onboarding.reaction: Noted. We'll suggest a gentle cutoff.

onboarding.prompt: Tap the evening slot for your wind-down reminder.
onboarding.reaction: Wind-down reminder set. Your future self says thanks.

phases.name: Ramp
benchmarks: Bedtime moves about 15 minutes earlier every few nights toward target
actions: Morning light within an hour of waking

phases.name: Hold
benchmarks: Same wake time at least 5 days a week
Average rested score up from week 1
actions: Weekend wake time within an hour of weekdays

plan_blueprint.calendar: A nightly wind-down reminder at the chosen slot, a caffeine cutoff reminder, and a fixed wake-time alarm note. Bedtime targets step earlier over the 14-night ramp.

approach_variants.habit: Wind-down stacked on an existing evening habit (brushing teeth); streak of on-time nights.
approach_variants.time: Exact calendar blocks for wind-down, lights out and wake; weekly review of sleep window.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward after night 7 and night 14.
approach_variants.resource: First nights set up a phone charging spot outside the bedroom, an alarm clock and a dark, cool room.

guardrails: Talk to your doctor before starting. GoalKin offers education, not medical advice.
Loud snoring, gasping at night, or ongoing trouble sleeping are worth raising with your doctor.
Don't drive or operate machinery when very sleepy.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A late night doesn't reset the ramp; the next night uses the same target. Three late nights in a row pause the ramp for a few days at the current bedtime before stepping earlier again.
